svg.aria-label: Geometric cubic box volume model versus empirical quadratic fit
svg.title: Geometric cubic box volume model versus empirical quadratic fit
svg.desc: Comparison of physical cubic volume model V(x) = 4x^3 - 40x^2 + 100x and analyst empirical quadratic fit Q(x) = -28x^2 + 92x.

g.text: 1 · Geometric formulation from 10 cm square sheet
Maximum at x = 5/3 ≈ 1.67 cm (V ≈ 74.07 cm³); smoothly reaches 0 at x = 5 cm.
3 · Analyst fitted quadratic Q(x) = -28x² + 92x matches 3 points only
Agrees at x = 0 (0), x = 1 (64), x = 2 (72). But has spurious zero at x = 23/7 ≈ 3.29 cm!
4 · Discriminating input x = 3 cm reveals divergence
At x = 3 cm: Physical V(3) = 48 cm³ versus Fitted Q(3) = 24 cm³ (factor of 2 difference!).
For x ∈ (23/7, 5), Q(x) < 0 predicts an impossible negative volume for a real box.
